subject: decision.node_mode
decision: publish at the level 1 branch instead of descending to a subtopic
reason: 20 repeat CV on 100 labels: precision at 10 percent coverage 0.985 against 0.970 and AURC 0.142 against 0.162; the cost is that the student sees the question in the theme and not in the subtopic

subject: decision.threshold_rule
decision: publish when the calibrated confidence reaches 0.95 instead of searching the OOF curve
reason: The search rule had nested precision 0.938 because it picks lucky points; a rule fixed a priori has no selection optimism

subject: lockbox
decision: merge the 20 lockbox questions back into the labeled set
reason: Q0252 and Q0303 were read during the v0.1 error analysis so the lockbox was no longer blind

subject: decision.min_branch_mass
decision: never publish without text evidence or with a branch mass below 0.30
reason: An empty question reached confidence 0.91 because the logistic extrapolated on length; 0.30 sits below the lowest published mass (0.41) so it is a safety net that blocks no current publication

subject: aggregate.recalibration
decision: keep the correctness model output without Platt recalibration
reason: Platt fitted on the outer CV rows left the row ECE unchanged (0.049 against 0.046) and halved coverage (37 against 75) by pulling down the top of the queue where the labels are 18 of 18 right
